import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;
import java.math.BigInteger;

public class Main {
    static final int MOD = 1000000007;
    static final int MAXN = 20;
    static int[][] a = new int[MAXN][MAXN];
    static int ans, n;
    static final int N = 2001000;
    static int[] f = new int[N];
    static int[] g = new int[N];
    static int[] b = new int[N];
    static int[] mp = new int[N];
    static int[] tot = new int[MAXN];
    static List<Integer>[] v = new List[MAXN];
    
    static {
        for (int i = 0; i < MAXN; i++) {
            v[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
    }
    
    static void reduce(int[] arr, int idx) {
        arr[idx] += arr[idx] >> 31 & MOD;
    }
    
    static int reduceVal(int x) {
        return (x + (x >> 31 & MOD)) % MOD;
    }
    
    static long modPow(long a, long b) {
        long ans = 1;
        for (; b > 0; b >>= 1, a = a * a % MOD) {
            if ((b & 1) == 1) {
                ans = ans * a % MOD;
            }
        }
        return ans;
    }
    
    static long modInv(long a) {
        return modPow(a, MOD - 2);
    }
    
    static long fac(long x) {
        return x == 0 ? 1 : fac(x - 1) * x % MOD;
    }
    
    static long C(long n, long m) {
        return fac(n) / fac(m) / fac(n - m);
    }
    
    static int pc(int x) {
        return Integer.bitCount(x);
    }
    
    static void fwt(int[] a, int lim) {
        if ((lim /= 2) == 0) return;
        for (int i = 0; i < lim; ++i) {
            a[i] = reduceVal(a[i] + a[i + lim]);
        }
        fwt(a, lim);
        fwt(a, lim + lim);
    }
    
    static void fwt2(int[] a, int lim) {
        if ((lim /= 2) == 0) return;
        for (int i = 0; i < lim; ++i) {
            a[i] = reduceVal(a[i] - a[i + lim]);
        }
        fwt2(a, lim);
        fwt2(a, lim + lim);
    }
    
    static void dfs(int x) {
    }
    
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                a[i][j] = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
                a[i][j] = (int) (a[i][j] * modInv(100) % MOD);
                b[i * n + j] = a[i][j];
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i < (1 << n); i++) {
            v[pc(i)].add(i);
            mp[i] = tot[pc(i)]++;
        }
        
        int m = n / 2;
        for (int i = 0; i < (1 << (m * n)); i++) {
            long p = 1;
            int[] S = new int[3];
            for (int j = 0; j < m * n; j++) {
                if ((i >> j & 1) == 1) {
                    p = p * b[j] % MOD;
                } else {
                    p = p * (MOD + 1 - b[j]) % MOD;
                }
            }
            for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) {
                S[j] = (i >> j * n) & ((1 << n) - 1);
            }
            int st = 0;
            for (int j : v[m]) {
                int[] s = new int[MAXN];
                int totCount = 0;
                for (int k = j; k > 0; k &= k - 1) {
                    s[totCount++] = Integer.numberOfTrailingZeros(k);
                }
                Arrays.sort(s, 0, totCount);
                do {
                    boolean valid = true;
                    for (int k = 0; k < m; k++) {
                        if (((S[k] >> s[k]) & 1) == 0) {
                            valid = false;
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                    if (valid) {
                        st |= 1 << mp[j];
                    }
                } while (nextPermutation(s, totCount));
            }
            f[st] = reduceVal(f[st] + (int) p - MOD);
        }
        
        int M = n - m;
        for (int i = 0; i < (1 << (M * n)); i++) {
            long p = 1;
            int[] S = new int[3];
            for (int j = 0; j < M * n; j++) {
                if ((i >> j & 1) == 1) {
                    p = p * b[j + n * m] % MOD;
                } else {
                    p = p * (MOD + 1 - b[j + n * m]) % MOD;
                }
            }
            for (int j = 0; j < M; j++) {
                S[j] = (i >> j * n) & ((1 << n) - 1);
            }
            int st = 0;
            for (int j : v[n - m]) {
                int[] s = new int[MAXN];
                int totCount = 0;
                for (int k = j; k > 0; k &= k - 1) {
                    s[totCount++] = Integer.numberOfTrailingZeros(k);
                }
                Arrays.sort(s, 0, totCount);
                do {
                    boolean valid = true;
                    for (int k = 0; k < M; k++) {
                        if (((S[k] >> s[k]) & 1) == 0) {
                            valid = false;
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                    if (valid) {
                        st |= 1 << mp[~j & ((1 << n) - 1)];
                    }
                } while (nextPermutation(s, totCount));
            }
            g[st] = reduceVal(g[st] + (int) p - MOD);
        }
        
        int ans = 0;
        fwt(f, 1 << tot[m]);
        fwt(g, 1 << tot[m]);
        for (int i = 0; i < (1 << tot[m]); i++) {
            f[i] = (int) ((long) f[i] * g[i] % MOD);
        }
        fwt2(f, 1 << tot[m]);
        for (int i = 1; i < (1 << tot[m]); i++) {
            ans = reduceVal(ans + f[i]);
        }
        
        System.out.println(ans);
    }
    
    static boolean nextPermutation(int[] arr, int len) {
        int i = len - 2;
        while (i >= 0 && arr[i] >= arr[i + 1]) {
            i--;
        }
        if (i < 0) {
            return false;
        }
        int j = len - 1;
        while (arr[j] <= arr[i]) {
            j--;
        }
        int temp = arr[i];
        arr[i] = arr[j];
        arr[j] = temp;
        reverse(arr, i + 1, len - 1);
        return true;
    }
    
    static void reverse(int[] arr, int start, int end) {
        while (start < end) {
            int temp = arr[start];
            arr[start] = arr[end];
            arr[end] = temp;
            start++;
            end--;
        }
    }
}
